units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:6:7">Y. Keth. VII, 31ᶜ</cite> top <he>הויין קריביה עַרְרִין ואמרין וכ׳</he> the relatives objected (to the verdict) and said &c. Ib. VI, 30ᵈ top <he>אשכחינון עֲרִירִין</he> he found them disputing (about the amount to be allowed for the wife’s toilet).
